author: Dragon_Girl404
body:
Hello, Avicus Senior Mods:

  • Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed): Dragon_Girl404
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: No Slow Down
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I am Tarheelkiwi, I was playing on my sister's account because she was the last on MC and I was too lazy to change accounts.  I was playing on Nexus with the scout kit when I was banned.  Not too sure why No Slow Down because you are given speed 2.  I don't know if there was some glitch that make me look like I was crouching or doing the sword thing where you hold down the right mouse button ( I have seen both ).  All in all, I am not hacking.  Once again I am Tarheelkiwi so I hope my rep will help me on this appeal.  Thank you!
-Dragon_Girl404
